**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.46%) BELOW TREND indicates equities outperforming but rates elevated; Yield Curve (Level 1.0024) 1W -0.91% → flat BELOW TREND and Dollar (Level 28.14) 1W -0.07% → flat BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +1.32% | 1M: -2.59%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +8.99%) ABOVE TREND show selective EM/China catch-up.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: ARKK (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +1.35%) ABOVE TREND, while IBIT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL suggests crypto flows steady.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: GLD (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +13.25% | 1M: +10.12%) ABOVE TREND; base metals/industrial signals mixed with CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND but CPER/GLD ratio ↓ falling signaling relative demand softness.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +9.26%) ABOVE TREND with oil ETFs BNO (1W: +4.77% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +3.11% | 1M: +15.84%) ABOVE TREND confirming cyclical commodity bid.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (8/11) and SPY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND support equity leadership; DIVERGENCE: QQQ (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -0.64%) RECOVERY and SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY show uneven tech momentum to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure (XLE (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +9.26%) ABOVE TREND) and precious metals (GLD (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to long-duration bonds (TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.46%) BELOW TREND) and utilities (XLU (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +9.26%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +4.65% | 1M: +0.29%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +13.99% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLU (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.46%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +4.77% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +3.11% | 1M: +15.84%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +13.25% | 1M: +10.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +0.30% | 1M: -4.34%) RECOVERY and watch CPER/GLD ratio ↓ falling for downside risk to industrial commodities.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -4.35%) BELOW TREND around 20 = complacency threshold; HYG (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +0.20%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND HYG/LQD divergence ~monitor near current spread ~0.75; XLK (1W: +4.65% | 1M: +0.29%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +4.12%) ABOVE TREND as growth/value pivot metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY ABOVE TREND show equity resilience but credit signals (HYG/LQD divergence) and CPER/GLD ratio mixed. Tech and Energy showing relative strength while credit stress and uneven tech momentum are the key divergences to monitor.
